JUDGES' REMUNERATION ACT 1971

JUDGES' REMUNERATION (AMENDMENT OF FIRST AND FIFTH SCHEDULES)
REGULATIONS 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 19 of the
Judges' Remuneration Act 1971 [ Act 45], the Yang di -Pertuan Agong, after consultation
with the Chief Justice, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Judges' Remuneration
(Amendment of First and Fifth Schedules) Regulations 2016.

(2) These Regulations shall be deemed to have come into operation
on 1 July 2015.

Amendment of First Schedule
2. The Judges' Remuneration Act 1971, which is referred to as the "principal Act" in
these Regulations , is amended by substituting for the First Schedule the following
Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE
[Subsection 2(1)]

(1) (2) (3)

Judges Salary (pensionable) Effective date

1. Chief Justice RM36,000.00 per month 1-7-2015

2. President of the Court of Appeal RM31,500.00 per month 1-7-2015

3. Chief Judge of the High Court RM30,500.00 per month 1-7-2015
 in Malaya

4. Chief Judge of the High Court RM30,000.00 per month 1-7-2015

in Sabah and Sarawak

5. Judges of the Federal Court RM28,500.00 per month 1-7-2015

(1) (2) (3)

Judges Salary (pensionable) Effective date

6. Judges of the Court of Appeal RM27,500.00 per month 1-7-2015

7. Judges of the High Courts in
Malaya and Sabah and Sarawak
RM26,500.00 per month   1-7-2015".

Amendment of Fifth Schedule
3. The Fifth Schedule to the principal Act is amended  in paragraph 1,
by substituting for the words "RM16,200.21" the words "RM25,500.00".

Made 9 March 2016
[PM(BK)R. 11030/10 Jld. 6; PN(PU2)91/IV]

  By Command

DATO' SRI MOHD. NAJIB BIN TUN HAJI ABDUL RAZAK
Prime Minister
